overview: Morichro is a master-level light side technique classified under Purification. Induces a deep Force trance that slows bodily functions to near zero, preserving life in stasis for extended periods without aging or decay. Ancient Jedi used morichro to survive catastrophic events and to imprison dangerous dark-side entities in suspended animation.
history:
Force scholars trace Morichro across eras recorded in holocrons, Jedi Archives data-tapes, and Sith tombs on Korriban and Dromund Kaas. Practitioners documented in High Republic · The Old Republic · Clone Wars · KOTOR II established the modern understanding of how this ability manifests in combat, meditation, and ritual.

During the Old Republic and Sith Empire conflicts, masters drilled Morichro into initiates as part of the standard curriculum for purification specialisation. Surviving battle logs from the Clone Wars and Galactic Civil War show the technique adapted to blaster-era warfare, starfighter engagements, and close-quarters lightsaber duels.

In the sequel era, surviving texts and oral traditions kept knowledge of Morichro alive even as the Jedi Temple fell and the Sith assumed new forms. Each generation reinterpreted the power through its own doctrine while the underlying Force mechanism — channelled midi-chlorian symbiosis and focused will — remained constant.

The Jedi teach that this ability must serve life, consent, and the greater good — never domination or fear.
significance:
Morichro exemplifies how purification abilities shape Force doctrine on the light side. At master mastery, users balance raw potential against discipline, emotional control, and the moral weight of their choices.

Historians note that armies and orders rose or fell partly on how widely and wisely this technique was taught. A single master of Morichro could turn a skirmish, break a siege, or unravel an enemy's will before blades crossed.

For students today — in academies, hidden enclaves, or alone with ancient texts — Morichro remains a benchmark of purification proficiency across the Star Wars saga.
